prompt: rust repr packed struct nested repr align member restriction
answer:
Rust forbids a `#[repr(packed)]` type from containing a `#[repr(align)]` type, including transitively through nested structs or unions. This produces error `E0588`.

```rust
#[repr(align(16))]
struct Aligned(i32);

#[repr(packed)]
struct Packed(Aligned); // error
```

The restriction applies even when the aligned type is nested indirectly:

```rust
#[repr(align(16))]
struct Aligned(i32);

struct Inner(Aligned);

#[repr(packed)]
struct Packed(Inner); // error
```

A type also cannot have both representation hints itself:

```rust
#[repr(packed, align(8))]
struct Invalid(i32); // error E0587
```

The reverse nesting is allowed:

```rust
#[repr(packed)]
struct Packed(i32);

#[repr(align(16))]
struct Aligned(Packed); // allowed
```

The restriction exists because GCC and MSVC differ in how packed and aligned nested structures determine the resulting alignment and layout. Rust therefore rejects the ambiguous combination rather than choosing compiler-specific behavior. References to fields of packed types also cannot be created because those fields may be unaligned.
